prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right agency depends on what you need (industry, services, budget, goals). I can recommend firms once I know more about your situation. To get you started, tell me the answers to these and I’ll build a tailored shortlist:

- What industry are you in (B2B, consumer, healthcare, nonprofit, e‑commerce, etc.)?
- What services do you need (branding, web design, SEO, PPC, social media, content, PR, analytics)?
- Monthly or project budget range?
- Timeline / launch date?
- Location preference (Baltimore, Annapolis, DC‑suburbs, remote okay)?
- Any must‑have experience (e.g., regulated industries, ecommerce platforms, past results)?

How to choose (quick checklist)
- Specialization & track record: look for case studies and measurable results in your industry.
- Client fit: size and type of clients the agency usually serves.
- Services & capabilities: do they cover strategy, creative, execution and analytics you need?
- Team & senior involvement: who will actually do the work?
- Reporting & KPIs: what metrics and frequency of updates will they provide?
- Pricing & contract terms: retainer vs. project vs. performance; cancellation terms.
- References & reviews: ask for 2–3 recent client references and check Clutch, Google, LinkedIn.
- Cultural fit & communication style: responsiveness and transparency matter.

Where to search for top Maryland agencies
- Clutch.co and UpCity (filter by Maryland, read reviews and case studies)
- Google Maps + Google Reviews
- Local business publications (Baltimore Business Journal, Washington Business Journal)
- LinkedIn (search agencies and see team bios)
- Industry associations (AMA chapters, local startup hubs, chambers)

Sample questions to ask an agency
- What similar clients have you worked with and what were the results?
- Who will be my day‑to‑day contact and what is the team makeup?
- What would a 3‑month strategy look like for our goals?
- Which tools do you use for reporting and how often will you meet?
- Can you provide references and a recent ROI example?

If you tell me your industry, goals and budget, I’ll produce a short list (3–6) of Maryland agencies that match and include why each might be a good fit. Which details can you share?
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
